findings.description: The overflow guard now computes math.log(self.multiplier, self.exp_base) separately, which raises ValueError for multiplier <= 0 (previously max/multiplier handled this differently for negative values). Zero multiplier raises ValueError in both versions, but the log of a negative multiplier now raises where before a negative quotient also raised; behavior is essentially unchanged.
findings.rationale: Mathematically log(max/mult) equals log(max)-log(mult) for positive values, so the rewrite is equivalent. No concrete failing trigger identified beyond multiplier<=0, which already failed before.
